recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, low-fidelity urban aesthetic featuring a blurred silhouette behind steamed glass, bisected by a semi-transparent horizontal bar containing high-contrast, hand-drawn style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure is obscured by condensation to create a sense of voyeurism.
The horizontal cyan bar provides a clean anchor for the complex typography.
Dark drop shadows on text create depth against the textured background.
The vertical lines of the shower stall frame the central subject.
coreInvariants: Steamed glass texture with water droplets
Semi-transparent horizontal banner across the middle third
High-contrast white text with black outlines/shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A centered, full-length human silhouette viewed from behind, filling the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal cyan banner located in the center-middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central text banner, move upward to the top metadata, then down to the secondary artist names at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sides of the frame consist of out-of-focus bathroom tiles and glass panels.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted flesh tones and desaturated grays from the background image.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan/Teal used for the semi-transparent central banner.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the primary typography to ensure legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with a high-value, medium-saturation pop in the center.
paletteRestrictions: Keep background tones earthy and desaturated

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Informal, aggressive script and sans-serif mix.
letterConstructionRules: Variable line weights suggesting marker or brush strokes
Heavy black drop shadows to separate text from the busy background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descenders on letters like 'g' and 'p'
Interlocking characters in the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of aggressive brush script for the title with a more legible, slightly distressed sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary raw, informal energy

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person's silhouette behind a heavily steamed shower glass door. The lighting should be dim and moody with a slight purple/brown tint. Add a semi-transparent cyan horizontal bar across the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, white, hand-drawn marker-style text over the cyan bar and at the top/bottom edges. Use heavy black drop shadows and thin black outlines on all text elements.

verificationChecks: Is the text legible against the background?
Does the steam effect look realistic?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no recognizable faces are visible through the steam.
Check that the drop shadows are consistent in direction.
Verify the cyan bar does not completely obscure the subject.
Confirm the overall mood is 'late night' and urban.
recipe.reuseFormula: Silhouette + Steamed Glass + Transparent Color Bar + Outlined Marker Type
